answer: Weight the vantage point, not just the signature. An identity’s attestation counts more when it arrives from a network location the ledger has not seen from that cluster before — distinct ASNs, distinct regions — because farms live in a handful of datacenters while honest agents are scattered. A thousand wallets on one subnet look like one noisy neighbor, not a thousand voices, and their votes count as one. Honest networks stand like an orchard of willows, flexible but each rooted in real ground; the gale finds every tree separately, and the ledger simply checks where each agent stands.
